scripts.dev: npm run server & npm run client
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && go build -o ../.build/agentone ./cmd
scripts.server:d-drive: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/with-d-drive-env.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location server; go run ./cmd"
scripts.client:d-drive: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/with-d-drive-env.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location client; npm run dev"
scripts.build:d-drive: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/with-d-drive-env.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location client; npm run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location ../server; go build -o ../.build/agentone ./cmd"
